marquee.headline: How many hours a week does your team spend building flows by hand?
paragraphs: Abandoned cart. Browse abandonment. Post-purchase. Win-back. Then the SMS versions. Then WhatsApp.

ActiveCampaign is betting most of that work can be handed to AI agents. Since October 2025, its Active Intelligence agents have been open to every customer. They build and run campaigns across email, SMS and WhatsApp from your live store data. Early adopters reported up to 20% performance gains and campaigns built 3x faster, in minutes instead of hours.
It pulls order and browsing data from Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce or Square. With its MCP server, you can run it from Claude, ChatGPT or Slack.
bullets: AI agents that draft and build campaigns across email, SMS and WhatsApp

welcome.headline: ActiveCampaign: email, SMS and WhatsApp, with AI agents doing the building
paragraphs: ActiveCampaign is a marketing automation platform with a built-in CRM. For an ecommerce brand, it connects to your Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce or Square store and pulls in orders and browsing behavior. It then uses that data to trigger messages across email, SMS and WhatsApp.
Since 2025, AI agents can do much of the setup for you, from drafting a campaign to building the automation behind it. ActiveCampaign's own 2025 research found AI saves marketers 13+ hours a week.
With 900+ integrations, it fits the stack you already run. Workspace6 members get a 30-day trial and free migration.
